notice.title: Users having issues with Rockbox for Y2.
notice.content: Rockbox 360p themes not working and music not reading from MicroSD.
notice.full_content:
Rockbox for Y2 has two open problems reported by the community:
- **360p themes do not apply.** The player keeps showing the stock 360p artwork. - **Music on a MicroSD card is not listed** after a Rockbox install.
If you rely on a MicroSD library, stay on Original Software until these are fixed.
> Restoring the original firmware takes one run of Updater CE. Music on your MicroSD card is left alone, but music saved to the Y2's internal storage is erased: on Y2 the Keep Data option in Updater CE 2.5.1 only carries data across between firmwares that are cross-compatible, and moving to Original Software is not one of those cases.
The steps are in the [Y2 stock restore guide](https://innioasis.app/guides/restore-original-y2.html).

notice.title: About Notices in Updater CE
notice.content: You'll get important alerts about device safety issues reported by the community here, such as when devices are being bricked by certain firmware.
notice.full_content:
Notices are how the community warns about device safety issues, firmware that should not be installed on a particular hardware revision, and new software releases.
- **Each notice has its own page** on this site, so a warning can be read in full instead of being cut down to one line. - **The app shows the same text**, with the notice's detail opening from the banner. - **A notice without a specific page** simply opens its own page here; a link to the bare site root is ignored.
Use the bell in the header to see the current notices at any time.
